tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get one provider (for example GitHub, AWS, Vercel, OpenAI): a one-line verdict on whether it reports a problem now, its active incidents, what people reported about it on outages.live in the last 24 hours (reviewed reports only, with a spike flag when many arrive in an hour), maintenance in progress

tools.name: list_feed
tools.description: List incidents across providers, the most recently updated first. By default only incidents that are open now. Narrow it with providers, category, and a minimum impact; set state to recent to add incidents resolved in the last days.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback to the outages.live team: a provider to add, data that looks wrong (a status that does not match the provider's own page, a missing or stale incident), or an idea. The team reads every message. Send only what the user agreed to share.

tools.name: report_affected
tools.description: Tell outages.live that an outage affects your user, as the "I'm affected" button on the outage page does. Call it only when your user says that the outage affects them, never on your own. Give the outage id that get_provider or list_feed returns. The count shows on the outage page at once, and each

tools.name: report_outage
tools.description: Report that a provider does not work for your user, as "Report an outage" on outages.live does, also when its status page shows no problem. Call it only when your user asks you to report it, never on your own. The outages.live team reviews each report, and only approved reports show on outages.live,

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_feed · Public sink: send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_feed · Public sink: send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
